band.note: Ages 13+ share one band. 6-12 has NO band - a ten-year-old should not be given an hour, and neither lever is applied to them. Their session is whatever their volume produces.

levers.appliesTo: any client below the band floor
levers.why: Free - no work is added or removed, only the interval between sets. Capped low for Lose Fat because short rest IS the method there; a fat-loss client resting three minutes is no longer doing fat-loss training.

levers.appliesTo: any client still below the floor after the rest lever
levers.why: On a fat-loss program conditioning is training, not padding. Reaching the floor on resistance sets alone would need roughly 68% more weekly volume, which is a different program rather than a longer session.

levers.appliesTo: any client above the band ceiling
levers.why: Hand to the existing time-cap engine, targeting the band ceiling.

conditioning.placement: end of session, after all resistance work and after any BodyDot correctives
conditioning.rounding:
UP - round to nearest 5 ABOVE. Rounding to nearest leaves sessions a
               minute or two under the floor and they never reach the band.

modalities.label: Steady cycle, row or incline walk
Circuit - sled push, carries, battle rope

conditioning.note: Not resistance volume. It never appears in the volume audit and never satisfies a muscle-group target.

interactionWithTimeCap.rule: The band fills a session to the floor; the time-cap button shrinks it to what the client has today. They do not conflict - a session filled to 55-60 sits under the 75 ceiling and the button is not shown.
interactionWithTimeCap.buttonLeverOrder: When the button IS pressed, conditioning is the first thing removed. It is the cheapest thing to lose and the client asked for a shorter session.

rejected.doubleLoseFatVolume: Proposed multipliers of 1.00/1.50/2.00/2.50/3.00 for Lose Fat would double its volume at 4 days and triple it at 6. In 14 of 15 muscle groups a fat-loss client would then out-train a muscle-building client - chest 16 sets against 12, quads 40 against 28. Rejected.
rejected.cutGetStrongerVolume: Proposed 0.42/0.63/0.84/1.05/1.15 for Get Stronger strips 16% of volume at 4 days to shorten sessions. Rejected - length is the time-cap button's job.
rejected.restAloneForLoseFat: A fat-loss beginner would need 405 s rest to reach 55 min on rest alone. Rejected.

validated.note: Across all 2,205 blocks excluding ages 6-12. The 21.7% over the ceiling are handed to the time-cap engine, which is by design, not a failure. No block is left short.
